privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Information about the protection of your personal data
privacy.cookie_settings_desc: You can change your cookie settings at any time.
privacy.overview_general_text: The following information provides a simple overview of what happens to your personal data when you visit this website. Personal data is any data with which you can be personally identified.
privacy.overview_collection_who: Who is responsible for data collection on this website?
privacy.overview_collection_who_text: Data processing on this website is carried out by the website operator. You can find their contact details in the
privacy.cookies_text: Our website uses cookies. These are small text files that your web browser stores on your device. Cookies help us make our website more user-friendly, effective, and secure.
privacy.cookies_session: Some cookies are 'session cookies'. Such cookies are automatically deleted at the end of your browser session. Other cookies remain on your device until you delete them yourself. Such cookies help us recognize you when you return to our website.
privacy.cookies_types: We use the following types of cookies:
privacy.cookies_necessary_desc: These cookies are required for basic website functionality (e.g., authentication, security).
privacy.cookies_analytics_desc: These cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our website.
privacy.cookies_marketing_desc: These cookies are used to make advertising more relevant to you.
privacy.server_logs_text: The provider of the pages automatically collects and stores information in so-called server log files, which your browser automatically transmits to us. These are:
privacy.server_logs_items: Browser type and version, Operating system, Referrer URL, Hostname of the accessing computer, Time of server request, IP address
privacy.contact_form_text: If you send us inquiries via the contact form, your details from the inquiry form, including the contact data you provided there, will be stored by us for the purpose of processing the inquiry and in case of follow-up questions. We do not share this data without your consent.
privacy.rights_text: You have the right to receive information free of charge at any time about the origin, recipient, and purpose of your stored personal data. You also have the right to request correction or deletion of this data.
privacy.rights_contact: You can contact us at any time with further questions on the topic of data protection.
privacy.rights_access_desc: You can request information about your processed data.
privacy.rights_rectification_desc: You can request the correction of incorrect data.
privacy.rights_erasure_desc: You can request the deletion of your data.
privacy.rights_restriction_desc: You can request the restriction of processing.
privacy.rights_portability_desc: You can receive your data in a common format.
privacy.rights_objection_desc: You can object to the processing of your data.
privacy.security_text: We use SSL encryption (Secure Socket Layer) in conjunction with the highest encryption level supported by your browser during website visits. Usually, this is 256-bit encryption. This site uses SSL encryption for security reasons and to protect the transmission of confidential content. You can recognize an encrypted connection by the fact that the address line of the browser changes from 'http://' to 'https://' and by the lock symbol in your browser line.
privacy.changes_text: We reserve the right to adapt this privacy policy so that it always complies with current legal requirements or to implement changes to our services in the privacy policy. The new privacy policy will then apply to your next visit.
